low: No flood threat expected. Keep following local weather updates.
Keep an emergency kit ready: documents in a waterproof bag, torch, medicines, drinking water.
moderate: Stay alert to rainfall and river-level updates.
Move important documents and valuables to a higher shelf.
Know your nearest relief camp and the safest route to it.
high: Prepare to move to higher ground at short notice.
Charge phones and power banks; keep the emergency kit by the door.
Move livestock and grain stocks to higher, safer places.
Avoid crossing flowing water, even if it looks shallow.
severe: Follow evacuation orders from the district administration immediately.
Move to a relief camp or higher ground now. Do not wait for water to enter your home.
Switch off electricity and gas before leaving.
Call 112 or 1070 if you or others are trapped.
